items.title_en: World’s Fastest Humanoid Robot Can Already Run Faster Than Usain Bolt
items.title_zh: 世界上最快的人形机器人已经比尤塞恩·博尔特跑得更快
items.summary_en: On August 17, 2026, Chinese robotics giant Unitree released a video of its Superman model displaying its athletic abilities. Despite its clunky-looking exterior, Unitree’s newest humanoid robot can perform a 2-meter vertical jump and land firmly on its feet, beating the record set by Christopher Spell in 2021 (1.70 meters) by quite a large margin.
